'''Byrsym''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] Territories.

==Description==
Byrsym was close to its system's sun, making it very hot during the day. During the night, when it was cooler, its population became more active. Byrsym had only one major [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], which catered for merchants and travelers. It was home to quite a lot of criminals.<ref name="FoR" />

==History==
Byrsym came under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], shortly after its [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]]. Following the Imperial occupation, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Torrin]] of the [[Lamont Dynasty of Daimar|Royal House of Daimar]] established a rebel cell on Byrsym that opposed the Empire. After the Empire blockaded the planet [[Daimar]], Torrin's father, [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mitar]], sent some of Daimar's important figures to travel to Byrsysm and make contact with Torrin there.<ref name="FoR" />
